holes.name: GoodLTC.theorem_1_2
holes.body:
/--
Statement of Theorem 1.2:

There exist explicit good locally testable codes (for every rate `ρ < 1`).
-/
theorem theorem_1_2 (ρ : ℝ≥0) (hρ : ρ < 1) :
    ∃ q, ∃ κ ≠ 0, ∃ (n : ℕ → ℕ), ∃ (𝒞 : (i : ℕ) → BinaryCode (n i)), IsGood 𝒞 ∧
      ∀ i, Nonempty (LTC q κ (𝒞 i)) ∧ rate (𝒞 i) ≥ ρ := by
  sorry
